rows.title_short: Philippine Rubber Research And Training Center Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"Philippine Rubber Research And Training Center Act Of 2009. Seeks to promote the Philippine rubber industry and increase income opportunities especially for the poor rubber farmers in Mindanao; develop the industry in order to address the need for focused programs and projects on research and development, as well as on training and capacity building of rubber producers and processors, and; beef up quality production of rubber and to meet the increasing demands for rubber both in local and international markets.

rows.abstract: \"Exchange Of Information On Tax Matters Act Of 2009.\" Seeks to comply with the Internationally Agreed Tax Standards (IATS) for Exchange of Information to effectively carry out the country's commitments under bilateral tax treaties designed to combat tax abuses; strengthen the authority of our tax administration to directly respond to request for tax information from treaty partners, and; provide sanctions for officers of banks and financial institutions for willful refusal to supply information and strict obligation of the requesting foreign tax authority to maintain confidentiality
